summary: Hand-built 7 transcendence commands (trending, diff, author, leaderboard, stack, watch category, dedupe) that compute over local browse history — none of these exist as generated typed endpoints because MCP Market's live site has no history/diff API at all.
reason: The generator only emits typed wrappers around live upstream endpoints; these commands instead query a local SQLite snapshot table (resource_snapshots) built up as the user browses, and one (stack) chains the live similar-tools endpoint multiple hops. This is intentionally hand-code per the Phase 1.5 absorb manifest.
validated_outcome: 127/127 live dogfood tests passing; each command verified live against mcpmarket.com.
